// Run from a checkout of main at 16c0d89cb, whose adjudication task is version 8, with this file copied into
// packages/pipeline/test/ and FIXTURE_OUT naming this directory's recorded.json. It is not part of the suite.
import { writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { Changeset, loadConfig, type RepositorySource } from "@melian-agent/core";
import {
	checksExtension,
	backgroundContext as context,
	createMemoryStorage,
	createNodeExecutionEnv,
	createReviewRegistry,
	openHarness,
	reviewChangeset,
	runChecks,
} from "@melian-agent/pipeline";
import { createFakeModels } from "@melian-agent/pipeline/testing";
import { expect, it } from "vitest";
import { AdjudicationTask } from "../src/adjudication.ts";
import { ReviewIndex } from "../src/review-index.ts";
import { commit, createRepository, lines, removeRepository } from "./fixtures/repo.ts";

it("records main's adjudication input for a review that counted a static check", { timeout: 120_000 }, async () => {
	const repo = createRepository();
	commit(repo, {
		"melian.yaml": lines("tiers:", "  fast: [static.tsc]"),
		"tsconfig.json": JSON.stringify({ compilerOptions: { strict: true, noEmit: true, target: "ES2022", module: "NodeNext" } }),
		"src/a.ts": lines("export const a: number = 1;"),
	});
	commit(repo, { "src/a.ts": lines("export const a: number = 'one';") });
	const fake = createFakeModels();
	const registry = createReviewRegistry();
	registry.install(checksExtension);
	const harness = await openHarness(createMemoryStorage(), {
		models: fake.models,
		registry,
		settings: { retry: { enabled: false } },
		env: () => createNodeExecutionEnv(repo),
	});
	try {
		const changeset = await Changeset.resolve(repo, "HEAD~1..HEAD");
		const source: RepositorySource = { kind: "revision", commit: changeset.revision.base };
		const { config } = await loadConfig(repo, source, "");
		const root = await harness.root(context);
		const checkRun = await runChecks(harness, { rootConversationId: root.id, changeset, config, source, tier: "fast" }, context);
		const { verdict } = await reviewChangeset({ harness, changeset, config, lenses: [], standards: [], models: fake.review, policy: source, tier: "fast", checkRun });
		expect(verdict.status).toBe("findings");
		const revision = `${changeset.revision.base}..${changeset.revision.head}`;
		const id = (await harness.snapshot(ReviewIndex, root.id, context))!.reviews[revision]!.adjudication!.task;
		const task = (await harness.getTask(id, context))!;
		expect(task.version).toBe(AdjudicationTask.definition.version);
		writeFileSync(
			process.env.FIXTURE_OUT!,
			`${JSON.stringify(
				{
					recordedBy: "packages/pipeline/test/fixtures/adjudication-v8-static/capture.test.ts at 16c0d89cb",
					repoRoot: repo,
					base: changeset.revision.base,
					head: changeset.revision.head,
					verdict: verdict.status,
					task: { kind: AdjudicationTask.definition.name, version: task.version, input: task.input, initial: AdjudicationTask.definition.initial(task.input as never) },
				},
				null,
				"\t",
			)}\n`,
		);
	} finally {
		await harness.close(context);
		removeRepository(repo);
	}
});
